card.name: Word before 'patient' in standard label phrases
card.fires_on: The word just before 'patient(s)' or an incidence phrase in fixed label sentences, such as 'individual' in 'consistent with individual patient treatment goals' or 'that'/'the' after 'showed' or a patient count.

modes.label: Treatment goals phrase
modes.description: 'individual' right after 'shortest duration consistent with' in opioid prescribing text.
modes.example: for the shortest duration that is consistent with<< individual>> patient treatment goals , monitor all patients regularly

modes.label: Trial results lead-in
modes.description: 'that' or 'the' opening the finding in pooled-trial summaries of suicidality or antiepileptic drugs.
modes.example: approximately 77,000 adult patients and 4,500 pediatric patients,<< the>> incidence of suicidal thoughts and behaviors in antidepress
